method_summary: Optimized v-space multihead retrieval with 2D-view softmax, Gram-matrix norm computation, 4D broadcast p@G, in-place ops, and alpha=1.0 shortcut. Raw ratio improved from 0.491 to 0.463 (~5.7% faster). Key wins: 2D-view softmax dispatch and Gram norm approach.

V-space projection kernel with 2D-view softmax, Gram-matrix norm computation, and F.scaled_dot_product_attention for the alpha=1.0 fast path. Non-alpha path computes q,k,v via 2D matmul, logits with transposed matmul, p0 and p1 softmaxes, p_mix via lerp, and ratio from Gram-matrix derived norms of p1 and p_mix against x. Raw CPU-time ratio improved from 0.4550 to 0.4535 (~0.3% better) and all 5 seeds pass numerical gates.
